name: harmonyos-migration-scaffold
title: HarmonyOS Migration Scaffold
job_to_be_done: Build and verify a non-business HarmonyOS NEXT native UI foundation from a frozen feature-semantic map. Scaffolds one ArkUI carrier per UI surface (routes for pages, modal mounts for sheets/dialogs, no shells for containers), declares interface-only semantic data contracts, and passes a four-rule machine Gate 3 (carrier coverage, data-contract closure, smoke chain, environment chain). No business logic.

trigger_surface.description: Build and verify a non-business HarmonyOS NEXT native UI foundation from a frozen feature-semantic map. Scaffolds one ArkUI carrier per UI surface (routes for pages, modal mounts for sheets/dialogs, no shells for containers), declares interface-only semantic data contracts, and passes a four-rule machine Gate 3 (carrier coverage, data-contract closure, smoke chain, environment chain). No business logic.
should_trigger: Create the HarmonyOS project base after the Android inventory is approved.

steps: Create real modules, routes, surfaces, public UI foundations, and interface-only capability contracts.
Build and verify the exact scaffold snapshot.
Produce the review packet and enter WAITING_HUMAN_REVIEW.
decision_points: Business logic is deferred to Phase 4.
A failed build or route check returns to governed rework.
failure_modes: Declared routes do not land on real surfaces.
Evidence is from a different snapshot.
